title: Set 295

sentences.ko: 아 그러니까 걔가 처음엔 좀 말이 없는데, 친해지면 진짜 웃겨. 그러니까 저녁 먹을 때 처음 10분 정도 좀 어색해도 한 번만 기회를 줘 봐. 갈수록 훨씬 나아지거든.
sentences.text: Okay, so he's really funny once he warms up, but he's kind of quiet at first. So if dinner feels a little awkward for the first ten minutes, just give him a chance, because he gets so much better.

alts.text: He's kinda shy at first, but once he warms up he's hilarious. So if dinner's a bit awkward for the first ten minutes, just give him a chance. He gets way better.

He is very funny once he becomes comfortable, but he is rather quiet at first. If dinner feels slightly awkward for the first ten minutes, please give him a chance, because he becomes much more engaging.

sentences.note: **warms up** 은 사람이 낯을 가리다가 편해지는 것을 말합니다. **give him a chance** 는 섣불리 판단하지 말고 기회를 줘 보라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구 소개팅 주선하면서 상대가 어떤 사람인지 설명하기

sentences.ko: 토요일 아침에 폰을 꺼 놓고 일요일 밤까지 안 켰어. 근데 솔직히 내가 없어진 걸 아무도 눈치 못 챘더라. 그게 서운할 줄 알았는데 오히려 좀 좋던데.
sentences.text: I turned my phone off Saturday morning and didn't turn it back on until Sunday night. And honestly, nobody even noticed I was gone, which I thought would bother me, but it was actually kind of nice.

alts.text: Turned my phone off Saturday morning and left it off till Sunday night. Nobody even noticed I was gone. Thought that'd bug me, but honestly it was kinda nice.

I turned off my phone on Saturday morning and did not turn it back on until Sunday night. To be honest, no one noticed my absence, which I expected would bother me, but it was actually rather pleasant.

sentences.note: **didn't turn it back on until** 은 ~할 때까지 다시 안 켰다는 뜻입니다. **kind of nice** 는 꽤 괜찮았다, 은근히 좋았다는 느낌으로 자주 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 상사한테 그만둘까 생각 중이라고 했더니 그 자리에서 바로 월급을 올려 주겠다는 거야. 그래서 지금 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어. 아니 돈이 더 들어오면 도움이야 되겠지만, 애초에 돈이 문제였던 적은 없었거든, 알지?
sentences.text: When I told my boss I was thinking about leaving, he offered me a raise right there. So now I don't know what to do. I mean, the money would help, but the money was never really the problem, you know?

alts.text: I told my boss I might quit, and he offered me a raise on the spot. Now I've got no clue what to do. The money'd help, sure, but it was never really about the money, you know?
When I informed my manager that I was considering leaving, he offered me a raise immediately. I am now uncertain what to do. The additional money would help, but money was never truly the issue.

sentences.note: **right there** 는 그 자리에서 바로라는 뜻입니다. **I mean** 은 말을 덧붙이거나 고쳐 말할 때 쓰는 말버릇으로, 아니 내 말은 정도의 느낌입니다.

sentences.ko: 강아지한테 80달러쯤 하는 비싼 침대를 사 줬는데 근처에도 안 가. 화장실 바닥에서 자는 게 더 좋은가 봐. 이제 거기가 걔 침대인가 봐.
sentences.text: We got the dog this fancy bed that cost like eighty bucks, and she won't even go near it. She'd rather sleep on the bathroom floor, so I guess that's her bed now.

alts.text: Dropped like eighty bucks on a fancy dog bed, and she won't touch it. Bathroom floor's her bed now, I guess.
We bought the dog an expensive bed that cost about eighty dollars, and she will not even approach it. She prefers to sleep on the bathroom floor, so I suppose that is now her bed.

sentences.note: **won't even go near it** 은 근처에도 안 간다는 강한 거부를 나타냅니다. **She'd rather** 는 차라리 ~하는 게 낫다, 더 좋아한다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 추수감사절에 이모가 다들 있는 데서 나한테 언제 결혼하냐고 묻는 거야. 그래서 만나는 사람도 없다고 했더니, 그 자리에서 식탁에 앉은 채로 자기 치과 선생님이랑 엮어 주려고 하더라니까!
sentences.text: At Thanksgiving, my aunt asked me in front of everybody when I'm getting married. And when I said I'm not even seeing anyone, she started trying to set me up with her dentist, right there at the table!

alts.text: My aunt asked me at Thanksgiving, in front of everyone, when I'm getting married. I said I'm not even seeing anybody, and she started trying to hook me up with her dentist, right there at the table!

At Thanksgiving, my aunt asked me in front of the entire family when I intend to marry. When I explained that I am not seeing anyone, she began trying to introduce me to her dentist, right there at the table!

sentences.note: **seeing anyone** 은 누군가와 사귀고 있다는 뜻입니다. **set me up with** 는 누구와 소개팅을 시켜 주다, 엮어 주다라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

reviewed: 1번 formal 의 he improves a great deal 은 사람이 아니라 실력을 말하는 것처럼 들려서 he becomes much more engaging 으로 고침
2번 casual 의 Phone went off 는 알람이 울렸다는 뜻으로도 읽혀서 Turned my phone off 로 고침
